designSource: 2026-10-16 initial screens; 2026-10-18 V1.2 desktop prototype and reusable desktop SVG assets
licenseNote: Project-specific derivative vector artwork. Do not assume third-party icon licensing for these files. UI icons come from lucide-react (ISC) and file-type icons from vscode-icons (MIT); see iconLibraries.

iconLibraries.name: lucide-react
iconLibraries.note: UI and action icons via src/components/Icon.tsx, bundled into dist by Vite.

iconLibraries.name: @iconify-json/vscode-icons
iconLibraries.note: File-type icons compiled on demand by unplugin-icons 24.0.0 via src/features/files/FileTypeIcon.tsx; no runtime CDN or auto-install.

usage: Treat these files as static assets under web/public; with Vite, refer to import.meta.env.BASE_URL + 'assets/...' (or /assets/... for root deployment). UI icons are imported from lucide-react via src/components/Icon.tsx; file-type icons are compiled from @iconify-json/vscode-icons via src/features/files/FileTypeIcon.tsx. Desktop wallpaper and the app-icons.svg symbol sprite are project-specific SVG assets under assets/desktop; use the wallpaper as a background and reference symbols with <svg><use href="/assets/desktop/app-icons.svg#cpu"></use></svg>.
